title: Hearing Sidney Bechet
summary: He heard Bechet in New York and admired his New Orleans style.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone

blocks.x: I see. Okay. I wanted to get that straight. Were you in the band at the time that Sidney Bâchet came briefly in to the band in New York? I think he only played with Duke you a couple of weeks or something.
That was before you were there, I guess.
In New York. I imagine that's where I heard him. Sure, I heard him.
And later he went to France; he lived in France.
What did you think of Bâchet's playing?
